title: Export complaints to CSV
goal: Compliance teams need to export what they see. Add GET /api/complaints/export.csv that returns the complaints matching the same filters the existing complaints list endpoint accepts, as RFC 4180 CSV with a header row and a Content-Disposition attachment filename containing the date. Protect against CSV/formula injection: any cell starting with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return must be prefixed with a single quote. Stream or bound the response so large exports do not exhaust memory (cap at 10,000 rows and say so in a response header). In the frontend Complaints page add an 'Export CSV' button that downloads the export for the current filters. Add backend tests for headers, escaping of commas/quotes/newlines, formula-injection protection, filtering and the row cap, and a frontend test for the button.
constraints: Reuse the existing query/filter logic rather than duplicating it. No new dependencies. All checks must pass.
